annotations.title: List countries, regions and cruising areas

description: The site's directory of places where boats stayed the night. With neither country nor area: each country with its number of places. With a country (directory slug or ISO code): its regions and cruising areas with their number of places. Each with the address of its directory page. With area (a cruising area's slug, as a country's areas give it): that area as its page shows it, its places with nights and their nights added up, and for each of the eight compass points the wind blew from, N to NW, the up to 3 places with the most nights in that wind at any strength, each with its nights, bay_id and page. A night counts in every wind boats stayed through, even for an hour, so one night can count in several directions and the directions are not to be added up. Give country or area, not both.

area.description: A cruising area's slug, as list_regions with a country gives it in areas (bay-of-islands). Answers that area as its page shows it. Not with country.

country.description: A country's directory slug (new-zealand) or ISO 3166 two-letter code (NZ). Every country when left out.

name: list_regions

places.description: At most 3 of the area's places, most nights in this wind first. Empty: none yet in this wind.

nights.description: Nights boats stayed here with the wind from this compass point, at any strength.

by_wind.description: The eight compass points the wind blew from, N to NW, each with the area's places with the most nights in it, as the page's "Nights boats stayed, by wind direction". A night counts in every wind boats stayed through, even for an hour, so one night can count in several directions and the directions are not to be added up. Null when the area has no place with nights, or none of its places has its nights counted by wind direction: its page then leaves the section out.

places.description: Places in the area where boats stayed the night.

area.description: With area: that cruising area as its page shows it.

about.description: The page that explains how the figures are known.
